decision: Legacy startup entries in accounts that never ran the updated build are not a first-release blocker, given limited existing app usage. Close #382 on the implemented and tested scope.
userStatement: I don't think that gap matters, nobody is really using this app yet, so that can close 382 I think?
approvedContractUnchanged: Active accounts clean managed startup files after uninstall; inactive accounts clean at next login; settings/data may remain and package scripts do not traverse user homes.
remainingReleaseVerification: Published-nightly lifecycle and real-channel AppImage replacement after merge, then exact stable assets; tracked under #384.
integrationStatusAtDecision: Both PRs open; code must merge before docs. Closure does not claim shipping.
